# Two lines of one invoice against one account, on an invoice and on a bill,
# and one of every flag this format carries.
#
# The two lines are what make `accumulate:` visible: asked for, GnuCash merges
# the two income (or expense) splits into one and the posting transaction
# carries two splits; refused, each line posts its own and it carries three. An
# invoice of one line posts the same transaction either way, so no fixture
# with one line can say whether the flag was read at all.
#
# The flags are here so a test can misspell one at a time: `active:` on both
# owners, `auto_apply_credit:` on the invoice, `from_credit:` on its payment,
# `closing:` on a transaction, and `taxable:`/`tax_included:` on every line.
#
# Every name and number here is invented.

2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	placeholder: false
	tax_related: false
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: Equity
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-ACC"
	name: "Accumulate Ltd"
	currency: CAD
	active: true

vendor "V-ACC"
	name: "Accumulate Supply"
	currency: CAD
	active: true

invoice "INV-ACC-001"
	customer_id: "C-ACC"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	auto_apply_credit: false
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Consulting, first week"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 10
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Consulting, second week"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 5
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-03-03
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-ACC-001"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-10
		amount: 100.00
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Part payment of INV-ACC-001"
		from_credit: false

bill "BILL-ACC-001"
	vendor_id: "V-ACC"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-05
		description: "Parts, first delivery"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 4
		price: 25
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-05
		description: "Parts, second delivery"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 2
		price: 25
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-05
		due: 2026-03-07
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "BILL-ACC-001"
		accumulate: true

2026-12-31 * "Close the year"
	closing: true
	Income:Sales -200.00 CAD
	Equity 200.00 CAD
